title: Loops
description:
Write these with loops:

| Function | Result |
|---|---|
| `sum_to(n)` | 1 + 2 + ... + n, or 0 when n < 1 |
| `factorial(n)` | n! for n from 0 to 20 (0! is 1) |
| `power(b, e)` | b to the power e, for e >= 0 |
| `count_digits(n)` | the decimal digits of an unsigned n (0 has 1 digit) |
| `gcd(a, b)` | the greatest common divisor of two positive numbers: while b is not 0, (a, b) becomes (b, a mod b) |

starter.solution.asm:
sum_to:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

factorial:
        mov     eax, 1
        ret

power:
        mov     eax, 1
        ret

count_digits:
        mov     eax, 1
        ret

gcd:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
sum_to:
        xor     eax, eax
        test    rdi, rdi
        jle     .done
.loop:  add     rax, rdi
        dec     rdi
        jnz     .loop
.done:  ret

factorial:
        mov     eax, 1
        cmp     rdi, 1
        jle     .done
.loop:  imul    rax, rdi
        dec     rdi
        cmp     rdi, 1
        jg      .loop
.done:  ret

power:
        mov     eax, 1
        test    rsi, rsi
        jz      .done
.loop:  imul    rax, rdi
        dec     rsi
        jnz     .loop
.done:  ret

count_digits:
        mov     rax, rdi
        mov     ecx, 10
        xor     r8d, r8d
.loop:  inc     r8
        xor     edx, edx
        div     rcx
        test    rax, rax
        jnz     .loop
        mov     rax, r8
        ret

gcd:
        mov     rax, rdi
        mov     rcx, rsi
.loop:  test    rcx, rcx
        jz      .done
        xor     edx, edx
        div     rcx                     ; rdx = a mod b
        mov     rax, rcx                ; a = b
        mov     rcx, rdx                ; b = the remainder
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

hints: A counted loop: a register for the counter, the work, `inc` or `dec`, `cmp` and a jump back. Check the stop condition at the top so a loop that should run 0 times does.
For `gcd`, `div` gives the remainder in `rdx`: move b into a, the remainder into b, and repeat while b is not 0.
unitTests:
test "sum_to"
    sum_to(10) == 55
    sum_to(1) == 1
    sum_to(0) == 0
    sum_to(-4) == 0
    sum_to(100000) == 5000050000
test "factorial"
    factorial(0) == 1
    factorial(1) == 1
    factorial(5) == 120
    factorial(20) == 2432902008176640000
test "power"
    power(2, 10) == 1024
    power(7, 0) == 1
    power(-3, 3) == -27
    power(10, 18) == 1000000000000000000
test "count_digits"
    count_digits(0) == 1
    count_digits(9) == 1
    count_digits(10) == 2
    count_digits(1234567) == 7
    count_digits(18446744073709551615) == 20
test "gcd"
    gcd(12, 18) == 6
    gcd(17, 5) == 1
    gcd(100, 25) == 25
    gcd(7, 7) == 7
